summary: Invariance from the law of the kernel (a phase of modulus one) and upperPairing_invariant; support from isNear_of_upperPairing_ne_zero.

steps.lean:
⟨fun s h ↦ (exists_floorGroup_mul_unipotentBelow (unitriGroup_anti le_self_add h)).elim fun _ ⟨_,
  _, b, _⟩ ↦ by simp_all [weightedSquare,
  hk.upperPairing_invariant, mul_mem_cancel_right, unipotentBelow_le_unitriGroup b, hk.law,
  ← ofReal_norm],
steps.claim: Invariance: for s ∈ Q_{j+1} ⊂ Q_j write s = γν (γ ∈ H_j, ν ∈ 𝒩_{<j}); in weightedSquare(F, j, k, x)(sg) = floorWeight(F, j, sg, x)·|upperPairing(F, j+1, k, sg, sgx)|², the weight is Q_j-invariant, ν changes the upper pairing only by a phase of modulus one (the law of the kernel), and γ does not change it (upperPairing_invariant, γ ∈ Q_{j+1} ∩ H_j).
Support: if weightedSquare(F, j, k, x, g) ≠ 0 then upperPairing(F, j+1, k, g, gx) ≠ 0, so g is near at j + 1 (field isNear_of_upperPairing_ne_zero).
